any: Well, look who it is. Hey, {other}.
{other}! Didn't think I'd see you in here.
At least I know someone. Hi, {other}.
Same crew, same cell block. Figures.
Oh, thank god, someone I know.
chatty: {other}! Save me a seat at dinner, yeah?
Oh, this is great. {other}, you have to tell me everything.
No way. The whole crew's ending up in here, isn't it?
cheerful: {other}! Best news I've had all week.
Hey, crewmate! Still owe me for that card game.
Well, this just got a lot less boring.
grumpy: {other}. Great. Now I get to hear you snore again.
Didn't think they'd catch you. Guess they caught everyone.
nervous: {other}? Oh, thank god. Stick with me, okay?
Is that {other}? Okay. Okay, good.
At least I'm not on my own in here.
quiet: Good to see a face I know.

any: Oh, you've got to be kidding me. {other}.
{other}. Stay out of my way in here.
Of all the cell blocks in the sector.
I know you, {other}. Don't think I forgot.
Great. Someone I can't stand, right off.
grumpy: {other}. You still owe me, and I haven't forgotten.
Should've known you'd end up in here too.
Of course. Of course they're here.
chatty: Well, if it isn't {other}. Lovely. Really.
{other}! Still telling people it was my fault?
You know who's in here? The one person I didn't want to see.
nervous: Oh no. {other}'s here.
Please tell me that's not {other}.
Oh, this is bad. This is really bad.
cheerful: Well, we'll just have to get along, won't we?

any: You've had it in for me since I got here.
This is about last time, isn't it?
You think I forgot what you did?
Every day it's something with you.
grumpy: I've put up with you long enough.
nervous: I didn't do anything to you, {other}! Back off!
Why is it always me?
Leave me alone! I mean it!
chatty: You want to talk about last time? Fine, let's talk.
Everyone knows what you did, {other}.
Go on, tell everyone your side. I'll wait.
cheerful: I was trying to be nice, {other}. I'm done trying.
I've been patient. I'm out of patience.

any: Hey. Hey! {other}, leave it. Not worth it.
{other}, look at me. Let it go.
You'll lose your yard time over this. Drop it.
chatty: {other}, you're better than this. Come on.
Guys, guys. Nobody needs a black eye today.
Come shoot some hoops with me, {other}. Forget them.
cheerful: Hey, hey. Let's all just calm down, okay?
{other}, come on, it's not worth it. Come sit with me.
grumpy: Knock it off, the pair of you.
nervous: Please don't. Please, {other}, it's not worth it.
Stop, both of you, before someone gets hurt.

any: Don't come back, {other}. I mean that nicely.
chatty: Write to me, {other}! Or don't. But do.
Tell everyone out there I said hi.
First drink's on you when I get out.
cheerful: Go on, {other}! Get out of here!
Have a real meal for me, okay?
grumpy: Don't do anything stupid out there, {other}.
nervous: It'll be weird in here without you, {other}.
Don't forget about us in here.

any: You too, {other}. Keep your head down.
Won't miss the food. Will miss you.
I'll see you when you're out.
chatty: I'll save you a stool at the bar, {other}.
Don't let them give my bunk to someone who snores.
cheerful: It won't be long for you either, {other}!
Keep smiling in here, all right?

any: Thanks for everything. I mean it.
You ran a decent place. Thanks.
Thanks, {staff}. Wasn't so bad in here.
Wasn't the worst stretch I've done. Thanks.
chatty: I'm telling everyone this was the best cell block in the sector!
Thanks, {staff}! Honestly, the food was all right.
cheerful: You were good to us, {staff}. Thanks.
grumpy: Don't let it go to your head, but thanks.
nervous: Thanks for keeping it calm in here.
Thank you. Really.

any: Finally. I'm out of this dump.
Hope you're proud of this place.
Nobody should be kept like that.
I'm telling everyone what this place is like.
grumpy: Starved and filthy the whole time. Great job.
chatty: Oh, I'll be talking about this place. Believe me.
Five stars for the door out.
nervous: I just want to go. Please.
Never again. Never.

chatty: Pull up a stool, {other}. I'll go easy on you.
Did I ever tell you about the game I lost a ship in?
Cards, anyone? Come on, it's better than staring at walls.
cheerful: Cards! Come on, it'll be fun.
One more round, I'm feeling lucky.
grumpy: This deck's got no luck in it.
nervous: We're not betting, right? Just playing?
Okay. Okay, I'm in.

chatty: Did you see that? Did everyone see that?
Keep dealing like that, {other}, I love it.
nervous: Wait, I won? Really?

any: Deal again. That one didn't count.
Nice hand, {staff}. Don't get used to it.
chatty: Okay, okay, best of five.
Staff shouldn't be allowed to win, {staff}. House rules.
nervous: I always lose.
Sorry. I'm bad at this.

any: You sit this one out. Rules.
Hey. Cards stay face down till I flip.
Not how we play. You're out this hand.
Put it back. That hand's dead.
grumpy: You pick it up, you're out. Everyone knows that.
chatty: Oh, come on, {staff}! Cards on the table!
In here that gets you a lot of dirty looks, you know.
cheerful: Ha, nice try! You're out this round.
Put it down, you'll ruin the surprise.
nervous: Um. You're supposed to leave it there.

any: Somebody took cards out of this deck.
Can't play a proper game with half a deck.
Whoever's got the aces, put them back.
grumpy: Some joker walked off with half the deck.
Every time. Every time someone pinches cards.
chatty: Whoever took the cards, I bet it was staff. I just know it.
Missing cards. Someone's building a card house somewhere.
cheerful: Deck's a bit thin. We'll manage.

chatty: I feel a big one coming, {other}.
Watch the wrist. It's all in the wrist.
grumpy: Stop blowing on it, {other}. Just throw.
nervous: Please be good. Please.

chatty: And the crowd goes wild!
Want to go again, {other}? You look like you want to go again.
grumpy: About time these dice did something.

any: It's my birthday, by the way.
Spending my birthday in a cell. Brilliant.
Happy birthday to me, I guess.
Of all days. It's my birthday.
They booked me in on my birthday. Classy.
chatty: It's my birthday! Does anyone get cake around here?
Birthday in the cell block. That's a new one for the list.
cheerful: Hey, it's my birthday! Still counts in here, right?
nervous: It's my birthday. Is that bad luck in here?

any: Still my birthday, if anyone's wondering.
Back home they'd be singing by now.
A cake would be nice. Just saying.
Birthday in the clink. Not how I pictured it.
Somebody should bake me a cake.
Wonder if the crew knows it's my birthday.
chatty: If anyone has a cake hidden, now's the time!
My mum makes a lemon cake every year. Miss that.
cheerful: Birthday's still a birthday. Even in here.
One more year! Cake would be a bonus.
grumpy: Great birthday. Ration paste and a bunk.
nervous: Nobody's going to do anything for my birthday, are they?

chatty: Happy birthday, {other}! Who baked this? I want to marry them.
Everybody sing! Come on!
cheerful: Happy birthday, {other}! Best day in here in ages!
grumpy: Happy birthday. Now cut the cake.
nervous: Happy birthday! We're allowed cake, right? We're allowed cake.

any: Best birthday I've had in years. Thanks, {staff}.
You didn't have to do that. Thank you.
That was really decent of you.
Nobody's done that for me in a long time. Thanks.
chatty: Thank you, {staff}! I'm telling everyone about this!
Best cake in the sector. Thanks!
cheerful: Thank you so much! That made my year.
grumpy: Thanks. Don't tell anyone I got soppy.
nervous: Thank you. Really. Thank you.

chatty: Did you see that? Did you all see that?
Somebody sign {other} up for the league!
grumpy: Fine. That was a good one.
nervous: Oh! It went in!

any: My nan shoots better than that.
Aim for the hoop, {staff}. The round thing.
Is the hoop too high for you?
chatty: Oh, that's embarrassing. Do it again so everyone sees.
Maybe stick to cards, {other}.
cheerful: Unlucky! You'll get the next one!
nervous: Oof.

chatty: {band}! Somebody write this down!
Folks, it's {band}. Tense stuff.
nervous: Is it {band}? It's {band}.

any: Good game, {staff}. Better luck next time.
Pay up, {staff}. Not really. But pay up.
chatty: The yard wins! Tell your friends, {staff}!
Rematch any time. We'll be here. Obviously.
grumpy: Game. Now go do some work.
Don't let it go to your head, {staff}.
chatty: We were going easy on you, obviously.
Best of three, {staff}. Come on.
nervous: Sorry. We'll play better next time.

any: Someone's scratched their name in here.
Other people's names on the wall. Cozy.
Somebody's been counting days on this wall.
Guess I'm not the first in this cell.
chatty: Ooh, cell art. The last lot had taste.
Look at that. Somebody left their mark.
grumpy: Somebody's been carving up my cell.
nervous: What happened to the last person in here?
Who were these people?

any: My mark's gone. Somebody cleaned it off.
That was mine. You scrubbed it.
Took me ages to scratch that in.
Oh, come on. You cleaned my wall?
chatty: That was art! You scrubbed off art!
Who cleans a cell wall? Honestly?
nervous: My mark's gone. Did I do something wrong?
Was I not allowed to do that?

replies: Could be worse. Could be in the next cell over.

conversations_friendly.opener: Save me a seat at dinner, {other}.
replies: Only if you give me your pudding.
Course. Who else would I sit with?

conversations_friendly.opener: When we're out, first round's on me.
Remember that job on the old freighter, {other}?
replies: How could I forget? You fell in the cargo hold.
Best week of my life. Until the fine.
Don't. I still dream about it.

conversations_friendly.opener: Want to shoot some hoops later?
You're the only sane one in here, {other}.

replies: My sister says hi. To everyone. It's weird.
They think I'm on a long haul job.

conversations_friendly.opener: I'd have gone mad in here without you.
replies: Don't go soft on me now.

conversations_friendly.opener: Watch my back in the yard, yeah?
We should start a band when we get out.
replies: We'd be terrible. Let's do it.
What would we even call it?
It's a small yard. Good luck.

conversations_hostile.opener: Keep looking at me like that, {other}.

replies: Take it up with my lawyer.
You'll get it when you get it.
They know what you told them.
And yet here you are, still talking.
Plenty of seats. Find your own.

conversations_hostile.opener: I'm counting the days till I never see you again, {other}.
You snore like a busted engine.
replies: At least I'm not a snitch.
You talk in your sleep. I've heard things.

conversations_hostile.opener: Why are you always hanging around, {other}?
replies: Relax. I'm not here for you.
What stuff? You own a spoon.
Then don't leave it lying around.
Staff are watching. Your lucky day.
